steps.en: A work item is created automatically after the offender's details are updated
steps.id: Work item dibuat otomatis setelah data offender diperbarui
steps.why_en: Only a button the officer presses posts a work item, and no matching system function was found.
steps.why_id: Hanya tombol yang ditekan officer yang membuat work item, dan fungsi sistem yang cocok tidak ditemukan.

steps.en: The officer sees the offence details of UPL notices awaiting a decision
steps.id: Officer melihat detail pelanggaran notice UPL yang menunggu keputusan
steps.why_en: A plain notice list exists on a hidden page; it is not a work item.
steps.why_id: Yang ada hanya daftar notice biasa di halaman tersembunyi; bukan work item.

steps.en: The work item includes the offender's past offences
steps.id: Work item memuat riwayat pelanggaran offender
steps.why_en: A history list was written but is not shown on any page.
steps.why_id: Daftar riwayat sudah dibuat tapi tidak ditampilkan di halaman mana pun.

steps.en: The work item is routed automatically to the officer's dashboard
steps.id: Work item diteruskan otomatis ke dashboard officer
steps.why_en: The dashboard page is empty and nothing allocates work to an officer.
steps.why_id: Halaman dashboard kosong dan tidak ada yang membagikan pekerjaan ke officer.
